title: Platform-reviewer return
description: Return shape of the reviewer role when it reviews a platform-testing pipeline phase (handover role platform-reviewer-phase<N>, N = 1-7: preflight, scaffold, inspect, selectors, compose, review, report). The verdict is recorded in tests/platform/docs/platform-onboarding-status.json. Gates the next transition: on approve, the orchestrator advances; on reject (cap 3), the orchestrator surgically fixes per findings + re-dispatches the same reviewer; on the 3rd consecutive reject the reviewer returns escalated-to-user and the run pauses for human triage.

phase.description: Platform pipeline phase being reviewed: 1=preflight, 2=scaffold, 3=inspect, 4=selectors, 5=compose, 6=review, 7=report. Matches the N of handover.role.

checklist.description: Per-item pass/fail of the platform phase exit criteria. An item that checks one row of the platform methodology table (the mobile nuances: app state and reset, permissions, keyboard, gestures, orientation, real versus virtual device, ...) names that row in section6-row.

section6-row.description: The methodology-table row this item ticks, by its nuance name, e.g. 'Permissions and system alerts'.

findings.description: Surgical fix list. Required when verdict == 'reject' or 'escalate'. Empty when verdict == 'approve'.

attestation.description: One-line summary of what was verified. Required when verdict == 'approve'.

authorizer.description: Required when the reviewer approves a skip / early-stop transition. Must carry either a verbatim user quote OR a documented structural exception.

reviewerCycle.description: Which review dispatch this is for the phase. The orchestrator increments per reject; the 3rd consecutive reject escalates.
